title: Collaborator (gateway session)
description: A person signed in through the auth-gateway's GitHub OAuth and listed in deploy/github-collaborators.txt. The gateway's `collaborator` tier as an actor (issue #1207): what it may do over HTTP is cat-harness/policies/http-gateway.jsonld, not a rung compared in code. Takes on no BPMN role; a person who works in a lane does so as the actor that lane's role names.
